MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/5] There were significantly greater reductions in CDRS and RADS scores from baseline to week 5 for the SPARX group compared with those who waited; however, there were no significant differences in the changes in the remaining self-report measures (Table 1). Effect sizes were 1.61 for CDRS-R and 0.77 for RADS-2. Those in the SPARX group were significantly more likely to be in remission or to have had a clinically significant reduction in symptoms than those in the wait group (Table 1).
